question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 3.
solution: Here the correct answer is **Away**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate option to **fill in the blank No. 3 **is: **away.** • In the context of the sentence, the word "away" fits best to convey the idea that Krishna had been miraculously taken to safety in Gokul. It implies a movement from one place to another(किसी विशेष स्थान, व्यक्ति या वस्तु से दूरी पर या उससे दूर।), indicating that Krishna was removed or rescued from the dungeon and brought to a safe location. • Example: "He had been miraculously spirited **away **to safety." • In this example, "spirited away" means being taken or removed quickly and secretly. • In summary, the most appropriate option to **fill in the blank No. 3** is **"away" **as it conveys the idea of Krishna being taken or rescued to safety from the dungeon. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Other options: • **around**: This option does not convey the intended meaning in the context of the sentence. "Around" typically denotes movement in a circular or surrounding manner(वृत्ताकार या वृत्ताकार दिशा में), which doesn't fit the idea of being taken to safety. • Example: "He was spirited around to safety." • This usage suggests movement in circles or random directions rather than being taken away to safety. • **together**: This option does not fit the context of the sentence. "Together" implies being in the company or presence of others (किसी अन्य व्यक्ति या लोगों के साथ या निकटता में।), but it does not convey the idea of being taken to safety. • Example: "He was spirited together to safety." • This usage does not convey the sense of rescue or removal. • **gone**: This option does not accurately capture the sense of being taken to safety. "Gone" suggests a departure or absence rather than being rescued or taken away (अब मौजूद या अस्तित्व में नहीं है). • Example: "He had been miraculously spirited gone to safety." • This usage does not convey the intended meaning. 45:Teb7, Here the correct answer is **Demoness**.
